dataset: CERT Insider Threat Dataset r4.2 (employee-day aggregates, logon/device/file/http/email)
split: 70% / 15% / 15% chronological by calendar date. Test: 45,460 employee-days (66 malicious, 0.145%). Validation: 45,138 employee-days (202 malicious). Thresholds selected on validation only.
limitations: Results copied from notebook CERT_r42_CARTS_All_Hybrid_Comparisons.ipynb (held-out test period). The notebook marks them exploratory: earlier development used test-period labels, so this is not a fully untouched holdout. ROC-AUC and PR-AUC are the notebook's 2-decimal percentages. The CARTS + RF + XGBoost model is NOT deployed: live /api/ml/predict still uses the active Random Forest artifact. ROC curve points were not exported.
